name: What factors affect the cost of drywall installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors affect the cost of drywall installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drywall hanging and finishing costs depend on total square footage, ceiling height, board type, and the complexity of room layouts. Standard eight-foot flat walls are the most straightforward and cost-effective. Expenses increase when a project includes vaulted ceilings, curved architecture, or moisture-resistant boards for bathrooms and basements. Labor also scales with the required finish level; a smooth Level 5 skim coat requires significantly more drying time and sanding than a standard knockdown texture. HH Remodeling evaluates these framing and surface details on-site to provide clear, upfront pricing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Drywall costs depend on room dimensions, ceiling height, sheetrock type, framing layout, and whether you choose a textured finish or a smooth Level 5 finish.
